title: 第17章 老妈王雅琴

第17章 老妈王雅琴-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

存书签

下一章

吴姜此刻正坐在回绿城的大巴上，王家的麻烦彻底了结，怀里还揣着一张百万巨款的银行卡，嘴角的笑意就没下去过。

从苍名县到绿城的大巴要走三个多小时，也没让人来接，出了车站就直接打了辆网约车，直奔万象城。

前后不过二十分钟，吴姜就拎着三个精致的手表盒子从万象城走了出来。

这很重要，关乎着他回家后能当“少爷”的时间长短。

重新打了辆网约车往家赶，车子很快就停在了一个环境不错的小区门口。

吴姜付了钱，拎着简单的行李下车，嘴里哼着小曲，步伐轻快的到了单元楼下。

他家住在十三楼，吴姜刚走到家门口，手指还没碰到密码锁，“咔哒”一声，房门就先一步打开了。

一道熟悉的身影快步迎了上来，声音里满是亲昵：“宝贝儿子回来了！想死妈妈了！”

王雅琴不由分说，上前双手捧住吴姜的脸，上下揉搓了起来。

吴姜的嘴被揉得嘟了起来，含糊不清地说道：“老妈，先让我进去行不行？肚子都快饿扁了！”

王雅琴这才放开儿子，吴姜趁机溜进家门，一股饭菜香瞬间扑面而来。

“老妈，你给我做什么好吃的了？”他伸着脖子往厨房瞅了瞅。

这会儿已经十二点多了，吴姜早上为了多睡几分钟，连早饭都没吃，一路颠簸下来，早已饿得肚子咕咕直叫了。

“等着，妈这就给你端出来！”王雅琴笑着应道，“今天特意留家里等你，都没去给你爸送饭呢。”

Wu Jiang was sitting on the bus back to Green City at the moment. The Wang family's troubles were completely resolved. He still had a bank card worth a million dollars in his arms, and the smile on his lips never faded.

The bus from Cangming County to Greentown took more than three hours, and there was no one to pick me up. After leaving the station, I took an online taxi and went straight to Vientiane City.

In less than twenty minutes, Wu Jiang walked out of Vientiane City carrying three exquisite watch boxes.

This is very important, related to the length of time he can be a "young master" after returning home.

I took another online taxi ride home, and the car quickly stopped at the entrance of a community with a nice environment.

Wu Jiang paid the money, got off the car with his simple luggage, hummed a tune, and walked briskly downstairs to the unit.

His family lived on the thirteenth floor. As soon as Wu Jiang walked to the door of his house, before his fingers touched the combination lock, the door opened with a "click".

A familiar figure came up to him quickly, his voice full of intimacy: "My dear son is back! I miss my mother so much!"

Wang Yaqin couldn't help but step forward, hold Wu Jiang's face with both hands, and rub it up and down.

Wu Jiang's mouth was rubbed so hard that he pouted, and he said vaguely: "Mom, can you let me in first? I'm almost hungry!"

Wang Yaqin then let go of her son, and Wu Jiang took the opportunity to sneak into the house, and the smell of food instantly hit his face.

"Mom, what delicious food did you make for me?" He stretched his neck and looked at the kitchen.

It was already past twelve o'clock. In order to sleep a few more minutes in the morning, Wu Jiang didn't even eat breakfast. After a bumpy ride, his stomach was already growling with hunger.

"Wait, mom will bring it out to you right now!" Wang Yaqin responded with a smile, "I stayed at home to wait for you today, and I didn't even go to deliver food to your dad."
